name: Main
description: Owns a page's gutters, reading measure, and vertical rhythm.

children.description: Page regions composed from Main.Header, Main.Description, Main.Content, and Main.Footer

measure.description: Maximum width applied to the page composition

as.description: Semantic HTML element rendered by the root

when: Laying out a page's header, description, content, and footer
Giving a page one consistent gutter and measure
whenNot: Arbitrary spacing inside a component (use Stack or Box)
guidelines: One Main per page owns the gutters — do not nest them
measure="narrow" caps content for reading; "full" uses the whole canvas
Compose regions with Main.Header, Main.Description, Main.Content, Main.Footer
Main.Description caps itself at 68ch regardless of measure
accessibility: Use the default main element unless an existing shell already owns the main landmark

examples.name: Full Measure
examples.description: Content fills the canvas, inset only by the page gutter.
examples.code:
import { Box } from '@/components/Box';
import { Main } from '@/components/Main';

<Box width="100%" border rounded="md">
  <Main measure="full">
    <Main.Header>Findings</Main.Header>
    <Main.Description>
      Every governance finding raised against this repository, newest first.
    </Main.Description>
    <Main.Content>
      Content stretches edge to edge, inset only by the page gutter.
    </Main.Content>
    <Main.Footer>Export report</Main.Footer>
  </Main>
</Box>

examples.name: Narrow Measure
examples.description: Caps content at the reading measure and centres it on wide screens.
examples.code:
import { Box } from '@/components/Box';
import { Main } from '@/components/Main';

<Box width="100%" border rounded="md">
  <Main measure="narrow">
    <Main.Header>Settings</Main.Header>
    <Main.Description>
      Manage the workspace contract, canonical components, and token files.
    </Main.Description>
    <Main.Content>
      Content is capped at the reading measure and centred, so long prose stays
      comfortable to read on wide displays.
    </Main.Content>
    <Main.Footer>Save changes</Main.Footer>
  </Main>
</Box>
